topic_title: Vehicle Maintenance for Safety — Tires, Brakes & Lights
prompt: What is the primary danger of driving on significantly underinflated tires on high-speed Texas highways?

The vehicle engine coolant temperature drops to freezing during cruise travel
Excessive sidewall flexing causes rapid heat buildup leading to sudden blowout
